derivation: from an unused root meaning to revolve (compare H2287 (חָגַג));

occurrences.text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
